verdict.rationale: jo is explicitly designed to be operated entirely through natural language across chat surfaces (Telegram, WhatsApp, email, macOS app) — creating/reading Linear issues, filing bugs, building websites, generating decks, and running briefings are all described as conversational asks ('ask jo to...', 'file a bug for...', 'what did I miss in #engineering?'). This is corroborated by runtime probes confirming the llms.txt describes it as a natural-language personal agent across these surfaces. Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports of actually issuing NL commands and observing correct execution, and no detail on command failure/ambiguity handling.
